title: Odoo Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the Odoo ERP web application.

ODOO_DB_TYPE.description: Database backend engine for Odoo (defaults to postgres).

ODOO_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or socket exposed by the Odoo reverse proxy.

ODOO_VERSION.description: Target Odoo release branch or version (e.g., 17.0, 18.0, latest) to install.

ODOO_DB_USER.description: PostgreSQL role used by Odoo to manage ERP databases.

ODOO_DB_HOST.description: Hostname or socket directory of the PostgreSQL server backing Odoo.

ODOO_WEBSERVER.description: Reverse-proxy web server fronting Odoo HTTP and longpolling ports (e.g., nginx, caddy).

ODOO_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem installation and addons directory for the Odoo application.

ODOO_SERVER_NAME.description: Public virtual host domain name configured for Odoo.

ODOO_DB_NAME.description: Default PostgreSQL database name initialized for Odoo.

ODOO_DB_PASS.description: Password authenticating the Odoo PostgreSQL database role.

ODOO_DB_PORT.description: TCP port of the PostgreSQL server backing Odoo (defaults to 5432).

ODOO_PORT.description: Internal HTTP service port bound by the Odoo server daemon (defaults to 8069).

db_strategy.description: Database provisioning strategy (local managed PostgreSQL vs remote connection).

db_url.description: Full database connection string or URL.

ODOO_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: Optional upstream FastCGI/proxy listen endpoint associated with Odoo auxiliary routes.
